title: 버스 정류장 노선도 읽기: 몇 번 버스, 어디까지 가요?
objective: You can read a bus stop route map and find the bus number, direction, stops, transfer point, and first and last bus times.
summary: Learners read a bus stop route map to find the right bus, its direction, and the first and last bus times.
note: This sign is an example. All names and numbers on it are made up.

task.title: Read the route map
task.line: Look at the sign on page 1 and find the answer to each question.

sections.heading: The sign: 하늘공원 bus stop
paragraphs: 꽃마을 ― ● 하늘공원 (현재 정류장) ― 중앙시장 ― 한빛병원 ― 시청역 (1호선 환승) ― 바다터미널 (종점)

items.text: Each stop has its own number, useful in bus apps.
The stop where you are standing now, often marked with ●.
The stop right after this one.
The bus goes toward this place; check it before you get on.
The end of the line; the bus does not go further.
The first bus of the day.
The last bus of the day.
You can change to the subway or another bus here.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: Read in this order: bus number → 방면 (direction) → ● 현재 정류장 → your stop. Stops after the ● are ahead of you; stops before it are already passed.
Times use the 24-hour clock: 23:00 is 밤 11시, 05:30 is 아침 5시 30분. Check 막차 before you go out late.

exercises: Find it on the sign. Write a number or a time: ① 이 정류장 번호는 뭐예요? ② 720번 막차는 몇 시예요? ③ 05번 첫차는 몇 시예요?
Which bus do you take? Write the bus number: ① 도서관에 가요. ② 병원에 가요. ③ 지하철 1호선을 타고 싶어요.
Look at the sign. Write O (true) or X (false): ① 720번은 시청 방면이에요. ② 720번 종점은 시청역이에요. ③ 720번: 하늘공원 다음 정류장은 중앙시장이에요. ④ 05번 버스는 밤 11시에도 있어요.
Fill in the blank with 첫차, 종점, or 환승: ① 아침 5시 30분이에요. 720번 ____를 타요. ② 05번 버스는 새봄아파트까지 가요. 새봄아파트가 ____이에요. ③ 720번을 타고 시청역에서 1호선으로 ____해요.
Answer in Korean with a full sentence: 바다터미널에 가고 싶어요. 몇 번 버스를 타요?
answers: ① O ② X (종점은 바다터미널이에요) ③ O ④ X (05번 막차는 22:00예요)
① 첫차 ② 종점 ③ 환승
